title: The Tech Bar
text: Tech Bar Rule of 7s: reserve equipment up to 7 days in advance and keep most equipment up to 7 days. Calculators are a 3-day loan. The late fee is $7 per day, per item. Items can be returned at any TAMU library Tech Bar location.

title: Bookdrop Locations
text: Return your books to any of these book drop locations: Evans Library Concourse; across from WERC on Bizzell Street; near Blocker and the Engineering/Physics building off Parking Area 7.
